anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: All the multitude of the sons of Israel shall slaughter it toward evening.
Israel: the one who sees God — Origen's standing etymology.

choices.why: Origen's Israel-etymology is the point of the clause.

pass_a_gloss: They shall slaughter him, all the multitude of sons of Israel, toward evening; and all multitude of sons of a human seeing God, that is of God's power; toward evening, toward the ends of the ages.
pass_b_english: And all the multitude of the sons of Israel shall slaughter him toward evening. And "all multitude" is of the sons of a human being who sees God — that is, of God's power. Toward evening: toward the ends of the ages.
source_text: Σφάξουσιν δὲ αὐτὸν πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος υ(ἱ)ῶν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ πρὸς ἑσπέραν· πᾶν δὲ πλῆθος υ(ἱ)ῶν ἀν(θρώπ)ου ὁρῶντος θ(εό)ν, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν δυνάμεως θ(εο)ῦ· πρὸς ἑσπέραν, πρὸς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων.
